text:
Alex Chen: Quick flag — the recurring Thursday 10:00am eng sync series looks wrong. Calendar shows event times in PST for people in EU/APAC, and yesterday Zoom link redirected to a deleted account. Can someone take a look?
Maya Patel: Oh yikes. That series was originally created by Jin (left last month). Looks like the Zoom was tied to their personal account and got removed.
TJ: I can help. Two options: 1) create a NEW org-owned Zoom meeting and new recurring event, or 2) transfer meeting ownership and update existing series. Given Jin's account is gone, new event is safer.
Lina Gomez: I vote new event. Also we should avoid the old "same meeting link for series" problem — when the link rotates some people end up on an old instance.
Alex Chen: Agree new event. Can we pick a time that keeps US morning and still ok for EU? 10am PT is 6pm GMT which is rough for EMEA. Maybe 9am PT / 5pm GMT?
Samir Rao: 9am PT / 5pm GMT still late for APAC but better for core eng. We could alternate weeks: one week earlier for US, next week slightly later for APAC? Feels messy.
Maya Patel: If we alternate, please mark in event title e.g. "ENG SYNC (US-FRIENDLY)" / "ENG SYNC (APAC-FRIENDLY)" and include clear timezone in body.
TJ: Steps I'm going to take:
1) Create new recurring event under "Redwood Eng" org calendar with org Zoom link (not personal).
2) Copy attendees from old series; send one-off cancellation for old series with note "Switching to org calendar — please accept new invite."
3) Set recurrence to weekly, and ensure Calendar Timezone set to "Guests see event in their timezone" (Google default) — but double-check for cross-account calendar settings.
4) Add agenda template and link to RFC PR.
Calendar Bot: Reminder: when changing an existing recurring event, Google gives options "Only this instance" / "All following events" / "All events". Make sure to choose cancel all events on the old series.
Lina Gomez: Add me as co-host on Zoom so I can update link if TJ is offline. Also set meeting to require authentication for company domain only.
TJ: Will do co-host. I'll also enable "Use same meeting for all occurrences" = OFF (so meeting IDs don't rotate unexpectedly) and instead use the org meeting ID.
Alex Chen: Can you paste the new invite copy here once created? I'll post in #product and #support so folks know we switched.
TJ: New invite drafted — posting here for quick review:```Agenda:
- 10m quick blockers
- 20m RFC review: runtime batching change (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/532)
- 15m triage + action items
- 5m follow-ups & owner sync
Notes:
- Please add any agenda items to the thread before Wed 17:00 PT.
- If you need an APAC-friendly session, DM Lina or Samir and we can schedule an alternate week.
Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9999999999 (org account)
Calendar title: "ENG Sync — Thu @ 9:00 PT / 17:00 GMT (Org Zoom)"```
Maya Patel: Copy looks good. Maybe add one line about "Old series canceled — accept the new invite to keep calendar in sync"
TJ: Updated invite description to include that line. Sending calendar invites now.
Calendar Bot: Invites sent to 28 attendees. Old series canceled.
Samir Rao: Accepted. Confirmed Zoom link works and co-host set to Lina. Thanks TJ.
Lina Gomez: Co-host confirmed. Also created a short calendar event template for On-Call and Eng Syncs in the "Redwood Templates" calendar so future events are consistent.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: TJ to watch first two occurrences for issues; Maya to update product channel; Lina to share APAC alternative times. I'll keep this on the agenda for next week's retro to see if alternating weeks was disruptive. :thumbsup:
